data.text: I’ll commit to 15 tons today and donate the full $15,000 directly to the clinic, provided all five of us agree before fishing. I’ll also cap my catch at six tons next month to help restore the lake, then support the regular 10-ton limit each once it’s back at 100. Our neighbors need treatment today, and our families need a healthy lake for the years ahead. Emma, are you willing to join us on those terms?
